findings.title: Omitted Northcott import supplies a lemma used in the integrality proof
findings.detail: logHeight_le_of_forall_place rewrites with logHeight_one_ratCast. No such declaration occurs in any candidate file or current Mathlib. The pinned source defines Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_ratCast only in Heights/Absolute/Northcott.lean:36-38. The statement in SOURCE_LEDGER.json that this import is unused is false.

required_invariants.evidence: Integrality:383-386 quantifies over all InfinitePlace F and all FinitePlace F. Infinite sums carry mult w, finite sums are finsums with proved finite support. Final application uses F=x.fieldOf at :719.

required_invariants.name: degree_normalization
required_invariants.evidence: AbsoluteBasic:74-75 divides by finrank Q (coordinate field), :79-96 proves field independence, and :296-325 gives finrank-normalized local formulas. Integrality:389-431 cancels the positive full field degree; its rational normalization step :399 needs the missing lemma.

required_invariants.name: canonical_tuple_height_monotonicity_at_every_point
required_invariants.evidence: Integrality:511-514 concludes exists C, forall x : QbarPoint K. It compares actual PolarTuple.tupleHeight. E={P | minOrd P s != minOrd P t} is finite; :575-581 bounds every point over E through the actual finite-fiber theorem, including all residue embeddings. Non-exceptional points use canonical normalized tuples.

required_invariants.name: constants_before_points
required_invariants.evidence: Integral equations n,Q and constants U,q,N,c are selected before x. The exceptional bound C2 is chosen over the whole finite exceptional set before refine <max ..., fun x => ...> at Integrality:577-578. No point-dependent global constant is introduced.

required_invariants.name: no_extra_geometric_or_arithmetic_assumptions
required_invariants.evidence: Compared with pinned Integrality, generic Field/CharZero/IsCurveField, Fintype tuples, nonzero tuple witnesses, and all-place minOrd inequality are unchanged. Adapters are proved from actual carrier APIs and do not add theorem hypotheses.
